semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides essential cleanroom cleaning equipment that supports the stringent cleanliness requirements in semiconductor fabrication environments.
summary: Taiwan Candear Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures specialized cleanroom cleaning equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their products, such as cyclone suction pads and shoe sole cleaners, are designed to prevent contaminants from entering clean environments, thereby maintaining the high cleanliness standards necessary for semiconductor fabrication.

Shoe sole cleaners for cleanroom entry
Caster cleaning systems for workplace cleanliness
